summary_for_children: Surah Hud tells how Nuh built the ark and was carried safely, and how Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Lut and Shu'ayb called their peoples.
environment_concept: The ark coast, following 11:36-48: a shipyard where the ark's last planks are fitted (11:37), the loading ground where animals come aboard two by two and the weather turns (11:40), a stormy bay with waves like mountains (11:42), the green slopes where the ark rests (11:44), and an empty tent with a roasted calf for guests (11:69). Nuh, his family and the guests are never shown; the animal kinds are the artist's choice.
architecture_and_scenery: Timber shipyard, rising flood plain, high waves, a mountain slope, and a tent where guests are welcomed.

palette.lighting: Grey storm light to clear sun
palette.atmosphere: Rain, wind, rising water, then clean air

areas.name: Shipyard
areas.description: Timbers, tools and the ark's frame.

areas.name: Rising Waters
areas.description: Water wells up across the plain.

areas.name: Waves like Mountains
areas.description: Huge waves seen from the deck.

areas.name: Slopes of al-Judiyy
areas.description: A green mountainside where the ark rests.

areas.name: Tent of Guests
areas.description: A welcoming tent; no one is shown.

activities.name: Build the ark
activities.description: Carry four planks to the glowing gaps on the ark's frame; when all are fitted the hull is complete.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Fair measure
activities.description: Balance a market scale so everyone receives full measure.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Two of each kind
activities.description: Guide the animals aboard in pairs: each pair goes to its own pen (giraffes, camels, sheep, elephants), and the food and water go to the hold. Then the rain begins. The kinds of animals are the artist's choice; the Quran says "of each [creature] two mates".
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator follows the Quran's order of events and labels added detail as explanation.
learning_objectives: Name the messengers in Surah Hud

status.playable_environment: first version built: its own scene (shipyard, loading ground with weather change, stormy bay, resting ark, tent) with two hands-on activities in the scene
status.testing: checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL at 960x600; not tested on phones or real GPUs
status.tested_by: automated screenshots of the scene and the in-scene activities

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
